scope: Distinguish repository, codebase, algorithm, semantic-oracle, and native-consumer independence claims.
Reconcile historical QCAD/LibreCAD product ancestry with the current LibreDWG and libdxfrw codebases without inferring source reuse.
Refresh the provenance treatment of the PAR-138 LibreDWG decode and other open-source peer routes.
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 optional peer manifest without increasing routine validation cost.

sources.name: GNU LibreDWG overview
sources.observed: The overview says LibreDWG came out of code from QCAD Community Edition. This is historical project-lineage evidence; it does not identify the current DWG reader files or establish present-day code reuse with libdxfrw.

sources.name: LibreCAD project history and libdxfrw README
sources.observed: LibreCAD documents its QCAD Community Edition fork history. The libdxfrw project describes itself as developed by LibreCAD contributors. Together these support possible common product ancestry with LibreDWG's reported origin, but do not prove code-level decoder sharing or a clean-room relationship.

sources.name: dwg-rs provenance and ACadSharp algorithm cross-check disclosure
sources.observed: dwg-rs describes itself as spec-first and discloses that its LZ77 offset interpretation was cross-checked against ACadSharp algorithm comments, without importing executable source. The comparison must therefore qualify independence by algorithm: a separate container implementation does not make that particular LZ77 algorithm witness independent.

sources.name: acad-ts project provenance
sources.observed: The project identifies acad-ts as a TypeScript port of ACadSharp. It is a separate package/runtime artifact, not a second parser lineage for format-semantic evidence.

sources.name: ezdxf ODA File Converter route and LibreCAD_3 consumer policy
sources.observed: ezdxf's odafc add-on invokes an installed external ODA File Converter for DWG conversion; the result belongs to that exact converter artifact, not ezdxf's DXF parser. LibreCAD_3 documents experimental read-only DWG through libdxfrw, so its import/build behavior is a downstream consumer check rather than an independent codec result.

The prior PAR-138 LibreDWG result remains useful source-distinct structural corroboration but is not treated as a clean-room or normative semantic oracle. method.kind: Read-only primary-source documentation/repository review and local plan reconciliation
method.limitations: The source pages are mutable, and product-history documentation does not establish code-level overlap between the current LibreDWG and libdxfrw DWG readers. No peer build or execution, native CAD qualification, sample download, or source-code ancestry audit was performed. The update is provenance/readiness guidance only and cannot promote support claims.
